def parse_pairs(text):
 out=[]
 for m in re.finditer(r'Demo pair \d+ input \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair \d+ output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance\.|\nSame instance\.|$)',text,re.S):
  parse=lambda s:[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in s.strip().splitlines()]
  out.append((parse(m.group(1)),parse(m.group(2))))
 return out
